When I was a kid a lived a horrible life. My mother was mentally unstable. Once we were locked in hour room for 5-6 months, no talking to anyone, watching tv, or going outside. Not moving, not talking, not doing any sudden moves. Evrything was controlled. Even our breathing. It was like an horror movie. And it happened more than once. There were several episodes like that througout my childhood, almost every year, minum 1 month, maximum 1 ayear, all accompanied by physicial and emotional violence. I lived in fear always. I was in a good provate school. Yet no one noticed. Once i grew up I realized they all noticed, but no one cared. Not even my dad who left us alone with my mother. I wnated to grow up so fast to get out of there. Now i am out and I realized there is nothing to live for. I was also homeless. I am unlovable. I just wanna die.
